name: unpainting
description: A Node.js watercolor and ink simulator that paints images one brushstroke at a time.

scripts.example:architecture: node tools/paint-plate.mjs --image examples/targets/trumbull.jpg --width 360 --mode fast --sheetmm 381 --valueplan examples/plans/trumbull-values.json --out work/trumbull
scripts.bench:build: node bench/scripts/build-results.mjs && node bench/scripts/build-leaderboard.mjs && node bench/scripts/build-findings.mjs && node bench/scripts/build-chart.mjs && node bench/scripts/build-overview.mjs && node bench/scripts/build-rounds-table.mjs
scripts.bench:test: node --test bench/scripts/lib.test.mjs bench/scripts/kit-log.test.mjs bench/scripts/rounds.test.mjs bench/scripts/overview-picks.test.mjs bench/scripts/rounds-table.test.mjs bench/scripts/runners.test.mjs bench/scripts/link-v4.test.mjs bench/scripts/fairness.test.mjs
